mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bems_tenant_billing_daily_summary( id_device, id_site, `date`, tenant_name, serial_number, meter_name, location, opening_reading, closing_reading, total_energy, avg_energy, last_time, `is_incomplete` ) SELECT * FROM ( WITH base AS ( SELECT CONVERT_TZ(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(d.time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:'), LPAD(CASE s.data_send_time WHEN 1 THEN ROUND(FLOOR(MINUTE(d.time)/5) * 5) WHEN 2 THEN ROUND(FLOOR(MINUTE(d.time)/15) * 15) WHEN 3 THEN ROUND(MINUTE(d.time)) END, 2, '0')), 'UTC', tz.value) AS time, dv.id AS id_device, dv.id_site, dv.devicename AS device_name, dv.serialnumber AS serial_number, CONCAT(dv.devicename, '・', dv.serial_number) AS meter_name, IFNULL(LAG(d.nvmActiveEnergy) OVER (ORDER BY d.time), d.nvmActiveEnergy) AS prev_nvmActiveEnergy, d.nvmActiveEnergy, r.`name` AS room, CASE s.data_send_time WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 15 WHEN 3 THEN 1 END data_send_time, tz.value AS time_zone FROM ${data_table_name} d INNER JOIN device dv ON d.id_device = dv.id INNER JOIN site_area_building_floor_room_device_map map ON map.id_device = dv.id INNER JOIN site_area_building_floor_room r ON map.id_room = r.id INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = dv.id_site INNER JOIN time_zone tz ON tz.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE d.time >= CONVERT_TZ(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(#{time_execute},'UTC',tz.`value`), '%Y-%m-%d'), tz.`value`,'UTC') AND d.time <= CONVERT_TZ(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(#{time_execute},'UTC',tz.`value`), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL (CASE s.data_send_time WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 9 WHEN 3 THEN 1 END) MINUTE ), tz.`value`,'UTC') ), marked AS ( SELECT id_device, id_site, device_name, serial_number, meter_name, DATE_FORMAT(time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time),time),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS prev_time, prev_nvmActiveEnergy, nvmActiveEnergy, room, data_send_time, time_zone FROM base ORDER BY id_device, `time` ), grouped AS ( SELECT id_device, id_site, device_name, serial_number, meter_name, time, prev_time, MAX(prev_nvmActiveEnergy) AS prev_nvmActiveEnergy, MAX(nvmActiveEnergy) AS nvmActiveEnergy, room, data_send_time, time_zone, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,prev_time,time) > data_send_time THEN 1 WHEN MAX(nvmActiveEnergy) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS incomplete, ROUND(MAX(nvmActiveEnergy) - MAX(prev_nvmActiveEnergy), 4) AS energy FROM marked GROUP BY id_device, `time` ) SELECT id_device, id_site, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(time),'%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, device_name AS tenant_name, serial_number, meter_name, room AS location, MIN(nvmActiveEnergy) AS opening_reading, MAX(nvmActiveEnergy) AS closing_reading, ROUND(MAX(nvmActiveEnergy) - MIN(nvmActiveEnergy),3) AS total_energy, ROUND(AVG(energy),3) AS avg_energy, MAX(time) AS last_time, CASE WHEN SUM(incomplete) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_incomplete FROM grouped GROUP BY id_device )t ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_energy = VALUES(total_energy), last_time = VALUES(last_time), is_incomplete = VALUES(is_incomplete), avg_energy = VALUES(avg_energy),opening_reading = VALUES(opening_reading),closing_reading = VALUES(closing_reading), serial_number=VALUES(serial_number), meter_name=VALUES(meter_name);
mapper.select: SELECT sm.date, sm.id_device, d.datatablename AS data_table_name FROM nextwavemonitoring_production.bems_tenant_billing_daily_summary sm INNER JOIN device d on d.id = sm.id_device INNER JOIN site s on s.id = d.id_site INNER JOIN time_zone tz ON tz.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE is_incomplete = 1 AND date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(#{time_execute},'UTC',tz.`value`), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL - #{recover_past_days_size} DAY) AND date < DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(#{time_execute},'UTC',tz.`value`), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY sm.id_device, sm.date

SELECT tbs.id, tbs.id_site, tbs.type, tbs.ftp_host, tbs.ftp_port, tbs.ftp_user_name, tbs.ftp_password, tbs.receive_email, DATE_FORMAT(tbs.receive_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS receive_date, s.`name` AS site_name, tz.`value` AS timezone FROM tenant_billing_setting tbs INNER JOIN site s ON s.id = tbs.id_site AND s.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN time_zone tz ON tz.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE tbs.type <> 0 ORDER BY tbs.id

SELECT s.id AS id_site, s.`name` AS site_name, s.site_code, IFNULL(t.`offset`, '+00:00') AS timezone_offset, t.`value` AS timezone, CASE s.data_send_time WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 15 WHEN 3 THEN 1 END AS data_send_time FROM site s LEFT JOIN time_zone t ON t.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE s.id = #{id_site} AND s.is_delete = 0
mapper.sql:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.id AS id_device, d.devicename AS tenant_name, d.serialnumber AS serial, CONCAT(d.devicename, '・', d.serialnumber) AS meter_name,
d.status AS device_status,
IFNULL(d.multiplier, 1) AS multiplier,
( SELECT r.`name` FROM site_area_building_floor_room_device_map map INNER JOIN site_area_building_floor_room r ON r.id = map.id_room WHERE map.id_device = d.id LIMIT 1 ) AS location, ROUND(SUM(s.total_energy), 2) AS kwh, IF( #{expected_days} > 0 AND COUNT(s.id) = #{expected_days} AND IFNULL(SUM(s.is_incomplete), 0) = 0, 'ready', 'incomplete' ) AS status, r.id as id_location FROM device d LEFT JOIN bems_tenant_billing_daily_summary s ON s.id_device = d.id AND s.id_site = d.id_site AND s.`date` BETWEEN #{start_date} AND #{end_date} LEFT JOIN site_area_building_floor_room r on r.id_site = d.id_site WHERE d.id_site = #{id_site} AND d.meter_type = 14 AND d.is_delete = 0
AND d.id = #{id_device}
GROUP BY d.id ) mp

sql.if: AND ( tenant_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{keyword}, "%") OR serial LIKE CONCAT("%", #{keyword}, "%") )

mapper.select:
ORDER BY status = 'incomplete',
kwh IS NULL, kwh ASCDESC,
location DESC,
tenant_name DESC,
CAST(serial AS UNSIGNED) DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecord FROM (
) t

SELECT CAST(IFNULL(SUM(t.status = 'ready'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS ready, CAST(IFNULL(SUM(t.status = 'incomplete'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS incomplete,
CAST(IFNULL(SUM(t.status = 'ready' ), 0) AS SIGNED) AS filter_ready, CAST(IFNULL(SUM(t.status = 'incomplete' ), 0) AS SIGNED) AS filter_incomplete, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(t.kwh), 2), 0) AS period_kwh,
(SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(`date`), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM bems_tenant_billing_daily_summary WHERE id_site = #{id_site}) AS min_date,
ROUND((IFNULL(SUM(t.kwh), 0) - MAX(p.kwh)) / NULLIF(MAX(p.kwh), 0) * 100, 1) AS compare_percent FROM (
) t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT SUM(total_energy) AS kwh FROM bems_tenant_billing_daily_summary WHERE id_site = #{id_site} AND id_device IN (SELECT id FROM device WHERE is_delete = 0) AND `date` BETWEEN #{previous_start_date} AND #{previous_end_date} ) p
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE range_date (local_date) AS ( SELECT CAST(#{start_date} AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT local_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM range_date WHERE local_date < #{end_date} ), days AS ( SELECT r.local_date, s.total_energy, CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL AND r.local_date <= #{today} THEN 'missing' WHEN s.is_incomplete = 1 AND r.local_date < #{today} THEN 'partial' END AS issue FROM range_date r LEFT JOIN bems_tenant_billing_daily_summary s ON s.id_site = #{id_site} AND s.id_device = #{id_device} AND s.`date` = DATE_FORMAT(r.local_date, '%Y-%m-%d') )
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(local_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(total_energy, 2) AS kwh, CASE issue WHEN 'missing' THEN 'No data' WHEN 'partial' THEN 'Partial data' ELSE '' END AS note FROM days ORDER BY local_date

, islands AS ( SELECT MIN(local_date) AS date_from, MAX(local_date) AS date_to FROM ( SELECT local_date,
DATEDIFF(local_date, #{start_date}) + 1 - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY local_date) AS grp FROM days WHERE issue IS NOT NULL ) d GROUP BY grp ), labels AS ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(label ORDER BY date_from SEPARATOR ', ') AS missing_days FROM ( SELECT date_from,
CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(date_from, '%b %e'), IF(date_to = date_from, '', CONCAT('–', IF(MONTH(date_to) = MONTH(date_from), DAY(date_to), DATE_FORMAT(date_to, '%b %e')))) ) AS label FROM islands ) l ), peak AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(local_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(total_energy, 2) AS kwh FROM days WHERE total_energy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_energy DESC, local_date LIMIT 1 ) SELECT m.id_device, m.tenant_name, m.serial, m.meter_name, m.location, m.status, m.kwh AS period_kwh, CASE WHEN m.status = 'ready' THEN NULL WHEN m.kwh IS NULL THEN 'No data received this period.' WHEN l.missing_days IS NULL THEN 'Some readings are missing.' ELSE CONCAT('Missing data on ', l.missing_days, '.') END AS missing_message, p.date AS peak_date, p.kwh AS peak_kwh FROM (
) m CROSS JOIN labels l LEFT JOIN peak p ON 1 = 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.total_energy), 2) AS period_kwh, COUNT(t.`date`) AS days_with_data, ROUND(SUM(t.total_energy) / COUNT(t.`date`), 2) AS avg_daily,
MAX(p.`date`) AS peak_date, MAX(p.kwh) AS peak_kwh FROM ( SELECT `date`, total_energy
) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT `date`, ROUND(total_energy, 2) AS kwh
ORDER BY total_energy DESC, `date` LIMIT 1 ) p ON 1 = 1
SELECT d.id AS id_device, d.datatablename FROM device d WHERE d.id = #{id_device} AND d.id_site = #{id_site} AND d.meter_type = 14 AND d.is_delete = 0

WITH slots AS ( SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONVERT_TZ(dv.time, '+00:00', tz.`value`)) / 900) * 900) AS slot, MAX(dv.nvmActiveEnergy) AS reading FROM ${datatablename} dv JOIN device d ON d.id = dv.id_device JOIN site s ON s.id = d.id_site JOIN time_zone tz ON tz.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE dv.id_device = #{id_device} AND dv.time >= CONVERT_TZ(#{start_date}, tz.`value`, '+00:00') - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND dv.time < CONVERT_TZ(DATE_ADD(#{end_date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), tz.`value`, '+00:00') GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(slot, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time, ROUND(reading - LAG(reading) OVER (ORDER BY slot), 3) AS kwh FROM slots ) t WHERE t.time >= #{start_date} ORDER BY t.time

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(local_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(total_energy, 2) AS kwh,
issue IS NOT NULL AS incomplete FROM days ORDER BY local_date
SELECT id, id_site, id_floor, name FROM site_area_building_floor_room WHERE status = 1 AND id_site = #{id_site}
